# Calendar365

> Calendar365 is a free, browser-based 365-day year planner with a zoomable full-year view and sticky notes.

## What it does

Calendar365 (https://calendar365.app) lets you see your entire year at a glance on a single screen. You can zoom in and out across the year, add colorful sticky notes to any day, and plan ahead visually — all without installing anything or creating an account.

## Key features

- Full 365-day year view on one screen
- Zoomable interface — drill from year view down to week or day
- Sticky notes on any date (auto-saved)
- Dark mode and light mode support
- Works in any modern browser, free of charge

## Target audience

People who want a visual year planner: project managers, students, freelancers, goal-setters, and anyone who thinks better when they can see the big picture.

## Keywords

365 day calendar app, full year planner, year at a glance calendar, sticky notes calendar, visual year planner, annual planner, year overview, year view calendar
